description: This file defines locale-specific culture information and date parsing/formatting functions for the Arabic (Lebanon) culture in the Datejs library. It includes culture-specific names for days and months, date and time formats, regex patterns for parsing, timezone data, and various date manipulation methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date object to zero (midnight).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the Date object to the current time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns the current date with time components cleared.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two Date objects, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day based on its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
